content.scenario: The government appoints Ms. Sharma as the Director-General under sub-section (2) of section 15 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, to oversee the national consumer protection agency and ensure enforcement of consumer rights across the country.
content.outcome: As the Director-General, Ms. Sharma is responsible for the overall strategy and enforcement of consumer protection laws, making her the main official in charge as defined by the Act.
